run_perf_baseline_cases: run performance baseline cases for diffusion test scenarios and output results to JSON
build_server_extra_args: build server extra arguments string from a DiffusionTestCase configuration for SGLANG serve
test_diffusion_case: test a diffusion test case by starting a server, running generation, and collecting performance metrics
run_single_baseline_case: run a single baseline case by ID and write the performance result to the baselines JSON file
match_baseline_cases: match baseline cases by name pattern or explicit case IDs from the command line
